ja276:1.1: Knowing your faith and your virtue, ruler of the people, we did
ja276:1.3: Exchange gold in Kaliṅga with the collyrium-coloured one.
ja276:2.2: he who comes here for my sake,
ja276:2.4: this was my former teachers’ word.
ja276:3.1: This elephant I give to you, brahmin,
ja276:3.2: Suitable, useful for a king, famous,
ja276:3.4: With a driver, go wherever you will.
